events.title: A Night to Remember: Mozart\, Beethoven\, Brahms and more.
events.location: Central Hall / Douwstra Auditorium\, 817 Peace St\, Pella\, IA\, United States
events.description:
Music performed by members of the New York Philharmonic
Chamber music performed by members of the New York Philharmonic will include Mozart\, Beethoven\, Brahms and more. 
The Pella Corporation and Central College speaker series\, The Front Row with Harry Smith\, welcomes a quartet comprised of members of the New York Philharmonic\, 7 p.m. Tuesday\, March 31\, Douwstra Auditorium. Doors open at 6:30 p.m. The concert is free and open to the public. 
Harry Smith\, a 1973 Central graduate\, award-winning broadcast journalist and internationally renowned storyteller\, will emcee this interactive and instructive special concert. 
“This virtuosic ensemble of violin\, viola\, cello and piano will perform pieces from various composers\, played in different configurations— solo\, duet\, trios and all four musicians together\,” Smith explains. “It’s a classical music sampler that will be powerful\, irresistibly beautiful and masterfully performed.” 
Members of the quartet will conduct a participatory session at Pella Community Schools working with students and Charlee Gililand Eekhoff\, 1999 Central alumna and Pella’s orchestra director. 
The musicians: Rebecca Young is the associate principal violist for the philharmonic. She is a Juilliard School of Music graduate and began her career with the orchestra while still a student. 
Pianist Eric Huebner holds the Anna-Maria and Stephen Kellen Piano Chair since 2012 and will be playing on Central’s Fazioli grand piano. 
Cellist Ru-Pei Yeh joined the NY Philharmonic in 2006. She has been playing professionally since the age of 10. A native of Taiwan\, she is a graduate of the New England Conservatory. 
Violinist Alina Ming Kobialka is a renowned soloist and joined the NY Philharmonic in 2022. She graduated from the Cleveland Institute of Music with her master’s in violin performance. 
This performance is made possible by funding from Pella Corporation\, Central and Smith. 
Pieces
Schumann: Piano Quartet in E flat Major First Movement 
Mozart: Divertimento in E flat major\, kv 563\, Allegro | Violin Viola Cello 
Brahms: Intermezzo No.2\, opus 119 | Piano 
Fauré: Piano Quartet\, opus 15\, Scherzo 
Handel-Halvorsen: Passacaglia | Violin Cello 
Dvorak: Piano Quartet\, opus 87\, Allegro moderate\, grazioso 
Beethoven: String trio opus 9 no. 1\, Presto 
Intermission 
Brahms: Piano Quartet in g minor\, opus 25 

Allegro
Intermezzo
Andante con moto
Rondo all’s Zingarese
